messages:
sara: Heads-up — saw a handful of 5xxs yesterday when token routing failed over from proj-A to proj-B. Quota billing ended up attributing to proj-B. Anyone else?

mike: Yea, saw same. Happened during the cross-region fallback window (~02:13 UTC). Router forwarded requests with the original key but we rewrote the origin header on the node.

anil: Right now the proxy sets X-Effective-Project to the local node project on failover. That breaks billing attribution. We should prefer X-Origin-Project when present and only fall back to effective.

jess: For the console/observability side — if we change precedence we need a new column in request logs: "Rendered billing project". PMs will ask where charges landed.

mike: Telemetry idea: emit metric `auth.attribution.override` with tags {from_project,to_project,reason}. Start sampling at 1% then ramp. That gives us visibility without huge cardinality.

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026 investigating token routing fallback (assigned: anil).

sara: Logs snippet from yesterday: ```INFO request_id=abc123 key=sa-99 x-origin-project=proj-A x-effective-project=proj-B reason=failover``` — we need those fields in the trace and in the quota evaluation path.

anil: Implementation note: the edge proxy has two knobs — `preserve_origin_on_failover` (bool) and `rewrite_origin_for_quota` (bool). Minimal safe change: set `preserve_origin_on_failover=true` so quota uses the original header.

mike: Rollout plan proposal: 1) dev/staging feature flag, 2) console opt-in for a subset of orgs for 2 weeks, 3) global flip + dashboard panels + regress alerts.

jess: UI copy draft idea: "Preserve original project attribution during routing failover (may affect routing latency)." Also add an info tooltip about billing impact.

sara: +1, but explicitly call out "This will change which project receives quota billing for previously failed-over requests." Also open a ticket to reconcile yesterday's misattributed window.

anil: Tests: add unit tests for header precedence and an e2e test that asserts quota-meter uses X-Origin-Project when present. Also add a small integration harness that replays the failover window.

mike: I'll open a PR for the proxy change and add the telemetry emit. PR will reference #INC-2026.

jess: I'll draft the console copy and a temporary opt-in toggle. Posting copy shortly. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: proxy/edge v1.84.3 -> canary at 03:20 UTC (will run with flag off by default).

sara: Thanks — once canary looks good let's enable preserve_origin_on_failover for the opt-in orgs and watch `auth.attribution.override`. :eyes:

mike: I'll wire the grafana panels and make a small alert if override rate > 0.5% for >10m.

anil: Note: put the reconcile ticket under billing team queue, because retro billing changes may be required.

jess: copy posted in #eng-product-review. pinging finance for the reconcile scope.

sara: Closing loop: follow-ups — PR number, dashboard links, reconcile ticket id. We'll update this thread.
